notes:
### Added

- **Auto-tag**: find accurate tags, covers and lyrics for many tracks at once. Tag your whole library from Settings > Content > Auto-tag library, or a folder, album, artist, genre or selection from its options. Sona picks the best match for every track and sorts them into Ready to save, Needs a look and No match. Tap a track's pen to choose among every match, cover and lyrics found for it, then save them all together. It keeps going while you use the rest of the app, with its progress in a notification.
- The lyrics sheet shows when lyrics for the playing track are being looked for online, and fills in by itself the moment they're found.
- A Play button in the tag editor plays the track you're editing.
- Keep the playback notification while Sona is closed, so headphones and Bluetooth can resume the last track: Settings > Playback > Persisted playback notification. It's on by default.

### Changed

- Excluded folders: add several at once from a sheet that sorts your folders into Music and Videos, and select excluded folders to let them back in.
- In the tag editor, Edit lyrics opens the lyrics editor as its own screen, and Save is a button at the bottom that appears once you've made changes.
- In the lyrics editor, a line is timed at the exact moment you press its clock, Undo and Redo are always in the top bar, the lines below a removed one slide up into place, and it remembers whether it follows the playing line.
- The widgets use the app's theme colours.
- The player, mini player and lyrics keep the theme's own text colours over cover backgrounds, which are now toned to match the theme.
- Tapping a widget opens the list that's playing with the full player over it, so the separate ⋮ button is gone.
- The Mini player widget shows the track's title alone, without the artist.

### Fixed

- Empty screens, like a library with no tracks, centre their whole message.
- Tag lookups no longer say "No match found" when Deezer was too busy to answer; they offer to try again instead.
- Shuffle and repeat on the home screen widgets no longer grow or get cut off when turned on.
- The widgets no longer flash "Nothing playing" before showing the last played track as the app starts.
- The Mini player widget no longer grows tall on Samsung phones.
